import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Laurent
import Mathlib.RingTheory.TensorProduct.Maps
import Mathlib.RingTheory.TensorProduct.MonoidAlgebra
import Mathlib.RingTheory.PolynomialAlgebra
import Mathlib.Algebra.MonoidAlgebra.MapDomain

set_option autoImplicit false
universe u
open Polynomial LaurentPolynomial TensorProduct
namespace AlgebraicGeometry
variable {k A : Type u} [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]

noncomputable def laurentBaseChange (k A : Type u) [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] :
    (LaurentPolynomial k) ⊗[k] A ≃ₐ[k] LaurentPolynomial A :=
  (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm k (LaurentPolynomial k) A).trans
    (((AddMonoidAlgebra.tensorEquiv (M := ℤ) k A k).restrictScalars k).trans
      (AddMonoidAlgebra.mapAlgEquiv k ℤ (Algebra.TensorProduct.rid k k A)))

private lemma mapAlgEquiv_single (n : ℤ) (x : A ⊗[k] k) :
    (AddMonoidAlgebra.mapAlgEquiv k ℤ (Algebra.TensorProduct.rid k k A))
        (AddMonoidAlgebra.single n x)
      = AddMonoidAlgebra.single n (Algebra.TensorProduct.rid k k A x) := by
  rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.mapAlgEquiv_apply]; exact AddMonoidAlgebra.mapAlgHom_single _ _ _

private lemma lbc_single (n : ℤ) (c : k) :
    laurentBaseChange k A (AddMonoidAlgebra.single n c ⊗ₜ 1)
      = AddMonoidAlgebra.single n (algebraMap k A c) := by
  simp only [laurentBaseChange, AlgEquiv.trans_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_tmul,
    AlgEquiv.restrictScalars_apply, AddMonoidAlgebra.tensorEquiv_tmul,
    map_one, one_mul, AddMonoidAlgebra.mapAlgHom_single, mapAlgEquiv_single,
    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.rid_tmul,
    Algebra.smul_def, mul_one]

theorem laurentBaseChange_tmul_one (x : LaurentPolynomial k) :
    laurentBaseChange k A (x ⊗ₜ[k] 1)
      = AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom (M := ℤ) (algebraMap k A) x := by
  have h : ((laurentBaseChange k A).toAlgHom.toRingHom.comp
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom))
      = (AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom (M := ℤ) (algebraMap k A)) := by
    apply AddMonoidAlgebra.ringHom_ext ?_ ?_
    · intro r
      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom_apply]
      show laurentBaseChange k A (AddMonoidAlgebra.single 0 r ⊗ₜ 1) = _
      rw [lbc_single, AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom_single]
    · intro m
      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom_apply]
      show laurentBaseChange k A (AddMonoidAlgebra.single m 1 ⊗ₜ 1) = _
      rw [lbc_single, AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom_single, map_one]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h x
#print axioms laurentBaseChange_tmul_one
end AlgebraicGeometry

16	`LaurentPolynomial A`.  A scheme consumer of `Scheme.cechPic_eq_one_of_forall_presenting_coboundary`
17	instead holds `Scheme.twoChartCoboundaryUnits V`, the coboundary subgroup of the scheme
18	restriction maps `X.resHom` on `Γ(X, V₀ ⊓ V₁)ˣ`.
19	
20	Both are literally `TruncExpCech.cechCoboundaryUnits` of the respective restriction ring homs
21	(`Scheme.twoChartCoboundaryUnits` unfolds to it by definition, `LaurentTwoChartCoboundary.lean`
22	and `TwoChartCechPicTrivial.lean:71`).  So an **identification of the two data** — ring
23	isomorphisms of the two chart section rings with `A[t]` and of the overlap section ring with
24	`A[T;T⁻¹]`, intertwining the scheme restrictions with `toLaurent`/`rightChart` — transports
25	coboundary membership between them.  This file is that seam: it consumes the identification as
26	hypotheses (the base-changed `ℙ¹_A` two-chart cover that realises them is the remaining scheme
27	build) and hands back the scheme-side `twoChartCoboundaryUnits` membership the criterion wants.
28	
29	Nothing here assumes the identifying isomorphisms are anything in particular, and nothing here
30	uses a new hypothesis on the ring `A`: it is the naturality of `cechCoboundaryUnits`
31	(`TruncExpCech.mem_cechCoboundaryUnits_map_iff`) instantiated at the two Laurent chart maps.

33	## Main declarations
34	
35	* `AlgebraicGeometry.mem_twoChartCoboundaryUnits_iff_laurent` — given the chart identification
36	  data, a scheme overlap unit is in `twoChartCoboundaryUnits V` iff its `A[T;T⁻¹]ˣ` image is in
37	  `laurentCoboundaryUnits A`.

52	Suppose the two-chart cover `V` of `X` is Laurent-identified over `A`: ring isomorphisms
53	`γ₀ : Γ(X, V false) ≃+* A[t]`, `γ₁ : Γ(X, V true) ≃+* A[t]` of the two chart section rings and
54	`γ₀₁ : Γ(X, V false ⊓ V true) ≃+* A[T;T⁻¹]` of the overlap section ring, intertwining the

56	(`Polynomial.toLaurent`, `rightChart A`):
57

59	* `hres₁ : γ₀₁ ∘ resHom(inf_le_right) = rightChart A ∘ γ₁`.

67	    (γ₀₁ : Γ(X, V false ⊓ V true) ≃+* LaurentPolynomial A)
68	    (hres₀ : (γ₀₁ : Γ(X, V false ⊓ V true) →+* LaurentPolynomial A).comp
69	        (X.resHom (inf_le_left : V false ⊓ V true ≤ V false))
70	      = (Polynomial.toLaurent : Polynomial A →+* LaurentPolynomial A).comp
71	        (γ₀ : Γ(X, V false) →+* Polynomial A))
72	    (hres₁ : (γ₀₁ : Γ(X, V false ⊓ V true) →+* LaurentPolynomial A).comp
73	        (X.resHom (inf_le_right : V false ⊓ V true ≤ V true))
74	      = (rightChart A).comp (γ₁ : Γ(X, V true) →+* Polynomial A))
75	    (u : Γ(X, V false ⊓ V true)ˣ) :

82	      (X.resHom (inf_le_right : V false ⊓ V true ≤ V true))
83	      (Polynomial.toLaurent : Polynomial A →+* LaurentPolynomial A) (rightChart A)
84	      γ₀ γ₁ γ₀₁ hres₀ hres₁ u

8	/-!
9	# Base change of sections along the projection `C ⊗ Spec A ⟶ C`
10	
11	For an object `C` of `Over (Spec k)` (`k` a field), a commutative `k`-algebra `A`, and a
12	quasi-compact quasi-separated open `V ⊆ C.left`, this file identifies the sections of the
13	base change `(C ⊗ Spec A).left` over the preimage `V_A := (fst C (Spec A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V` of
14	`V` under the first projection with the tensor product of the sections over `V`:
15	
16	`Γ(C.left, V) ⊗[k] A ≃+* Γ((C ⊗ overSpec k A).left, V_A)`
17	
18	(`AlgebraicGeometry.Over.sectionsBaseChange`), sending `s ⊗ a` to the product of the two
19	pullbacks (`sectionsBaseChange_tmul`), compatibly with restriction along `W ≤ V`
20	(`sectionsBaseChange_naturality`). Here `C ⊗ T` is the cartesian-monoidal product of
21	`Over (Spec k)`, realized by `Limits.pullback`; the single bridge lemma between the two
22	languages is `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.isPullback_left`.
23	
24	This is brick 1 of the separatedness ledger (design §4.4): one brick, three consumers —
25	étale separatedness (arbitrary `A`), the dual-numbers tangent engine (`A = k[ε]`), and the
26	χ-ledger under field extension (`A = K`). Hence the statements are for an arbitrary
27	commutative `k`-algebra `A`, and `V` is allowed to be any quasi-compact quasi-separated
28	open (e.g. the intersection of two affines of the curve), not just an affine one.
29	
30	## Main declarations
31	
32	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.isPullback_left` — the bridge: for `X T : Over S`, the scheme-level
33	  square `(fst X T).left, (snd X T).left, X.hom, T.hom` is a pullback.
34	* `AlgebraicGeometry.overSpec k A` — `Spec A` as an object of `Over (Spec k)`, together with
35	  the instance `Flat (overSpec k A).hom` (automatic over a field).
36	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.sectionsAlgebra` — the `k`-algebra structure on `Γ(X.left, V)` by
37	  restriction of scalars along the structure morphism. Deliberately **not** a global instance
38	  (house rule, cf. `Scheme.overModule`); consumers activate it with
39	  `attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra`.
40	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.resAlgHom` — restriction of sections as a `k`-algebra homomorphism.
41	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.isPushout_sections_of_isAffineOpen`,
42	  `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.isPushout_sections` — the master pushout squares on sections, for
43	  an arbitrary test object `T` with `T.left` affine (affine `V` needs no flatness; qcqs `V`
44	  needs `[Flat T.hom]`).
45	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.isPushout_algebraMap_sections` — the same square with the
46	  `Γ(Spec k, ⊤)`/`Γ(Spec A, ⊤)` corners replaced by `k` and `A`.
47	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.sectionsBaseChangeIso`, `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.sectionsBaseChange`
48	  — the comparison isomorphism (in `CommRingCat`, resp. as a ring equivalence), with the
49	  computation rules `sectionsBaseChange_tmul_one`, `sectionsBaseChange_one_tmul`,
50	  `sectionsBaseChange_tmul` and the restriction-naturality
51	  `sectionsBaseChange_naturality`.
52	
53	## Implementation notes
54	
55	The heavy lifting is mathlib's `pushoutSection` API
56	(`Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Morphisms/Flat.lean`): for a pullback square of schemes the
57	canonical map `Γ(X, Uₓ) ⊗[Γ(S, Uₛ)] Γ(T, Uₜ) ⟶ Γ(X ×ₛ T, ...)` is an isomorphism for
58	affine `Uₛ, Uₜ` and qcqs `Uₓ` when `T ⟶ S` is flat — which over a field is automatic.
59	This file only supplies the Over-category bridge, the corner bookkeeping (`ΓSpecIso`), and
60	the tensor-product face.
61	
62	The `k`-linear faces consumers may need are one line away from `sectionsBaseChange`:
63	it is `k`-algebra-compatible by `sectionsBaseChange_tmul_one` applied to
64	`algebraMap k Γ(X.left, V) r` (both sides land in the structure-map image), and
65	`A`-algebra-compatible by `sectionsBaseChange_one_tmul`.
66	-/

299	  Over.sectionsBaseChange X A hV.isCompact hV.isQuasiSeparated
300	
301	theorem Over.sectionsBaseChange_tmul_one {V : X.left.Opens}
302	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set X.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set X.left))
303	    (s : Γ(X.left, V)) :
304	    Over.sectionsBaseChange X A hV hV' (s ⊗ₜ 1) =
305	      (fst X (overSpec k A)).left.appLE V ((fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl s :=
306	  congr($((CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct k Γ(X.left, V) A).inl_isoIsPushout_hom _ _
307	    (Over.isPushout_algebraMap_sections X A hV hV')).hom s)
308	
309	theorem Over.sectionsBaseChange_one_tmul {V : X.left.Opens}
310	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set X.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set X.left)) (a : A) :
311	    Over.sectionsBaseChange X A hV hV' (1 ⊗ₜ a) =
312	      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv ≫
313	        (snd X (overSpec k A)).left.appLE ⊤ ((fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
314	          (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd X (overSpec k A)).left).ge)) a :=
315	  congr($((CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct k Γ(X.left, V) A).inr_isoIsPushout_hom _ _
316	    (Over.isPushout_algebraMap_sections X A hV hV')).hom a)
317	
318	/-- The base-change equivalence on a pure tensor: `s ⊗ a` goes to the product of the
319	pullback of `s` along the first projection and the pullback of `a` along the second. -/
320	theorem Over.sectionsBaseChange_tmul {V : X.left.Opens}
321	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set X.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set X.left))
322	    (s : Γ(X.left, V)) (a : A) :
323	    Over.sectionsBaseChange X A hV hV' (s ⊗ₜ a) =
324	      (fst X (overSpec k A)).left.appLE V ((fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl s *
325	      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv ≫
326	        (snd X (overSpec k A)).left.appLE ⊤ ((fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
327	          (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd X (overSpec k A)).left).ge)) a := by
328	  have h : (s ⊗ₜ[k] a : Γ(X.left, V) ⊗[k] A) = (s ⊗ₜ 1) * (1 ⊗ₜ a) := by
329	    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one, one_mul]
330	  rw [h, map_mul, Over.sectionsBaseChange_tmul_one, Over.sectionsBaseChange_one_tmul]
331	
332	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
333	/-- **Naturality of the base-change equivalence in the open**: for `W ≤ V` (both qcqs),
334	restricting the base-changed section is base-changing the restriction. The map on tensor
335	products is `Algebra.TensorProduct.map` of the restriction `Over.resAlgHom` and the
336	identity of `A`. -/
337	theorem Over.sectionsBaseChange_naturality {V W : X.left.Opens}
338	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set X.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set X.left))
339	    (hW : IsCompact (W : Set X.left)) (hW' : IsQuasiSeparated (W : Set X.left))
340	    (hWV : W ≤ V) (x : Γ(X.left, V) ⊗[k] A) :
341	    (X ⊗ overSpec k A).left.presheaf.map
342	        (homOfLE (show (fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ W ≤
343	          (fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V by gcongr)).op
344	      (Over.sectionsBaseChange X A hV hV' x) =
345	      Over.sectionsBaseChange X A hW hW'
346	        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Over.resAlgHom X hWV) (AlgHom.id k A) x) := by
347	  induction x with
348	  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
349	  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
350	  | tmul s a =>
351	    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, AlgHom.coe_id, id_eq, Over.resAlgHom_apply,
352	      Over.sectionsBaseChange_tmul, Over.sectionsBaseChange_tmul, map_mul]
353	    congr 1
354	    · rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.appLE_map, ← CommRingCat.comp_apply,
355	        Scheme.Hom.map_appLE]
356	    · rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Category.assoc, Scheme.Hom.appLE_map]
357	
358	end TensorFace

9	# The Laurent chart pair on the projective line
10	
11	Continuation of `AlgebraicJacobian.Curve.P1`: the overlap `D₊(X₀X₁)` of the two standard
12	charts of `P1 k` and its identification with the Laurent polynomial ring, the section-level
13	chart identifications, and the bundled chart package.

15	* `P1.overlapAlgEquiv : (k[X₀,X₁]_(X₀X₁))₀ ≃ₐ[k] k[T,T⁻¹]`, with the two restriction maps
16	  `P1.awayToOverlapLeft/Right` becoming `t ↦ T` and `t ↦ T⁻¹`
17	  (`P1.overlapAlgEquiv_awayToOverlapLeft`/`Right`);
18	* the *Laurent span* property `P1.exists_awayToOverlap_add`: every element of the overlap
19	  ring is a sum of restrictions from the two charts;
20	* section-level versions of all of the above (`P1.chartSectionsEquiv₀/₁`,
21	  `P1.overlapSectionsEquiv`, `P1.overlapSectionsEquiv_res_left/right`);
22	* the package `AlgebraicGeometry.LaurentChartPair` with canonical term
23	  `P1.laurentChartPair k`, and the span property `LaurentChartPair.exists_res_add_res`
24	  for any such package. This package is exactly what the two-lattice finiteness argument
25	  for `H¹(C, 𝒪_C)` consumes.
26	-/

42	/-- The standard grading of `k[X₀, X₁]`, the graded ring underlying `P1 k`. -/
43	local notation "𝒜" => homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k
44	
45	/-! ### The overlap `D₊(X₀X₁)` and the identification with Laurent polynomials -/
46	
47	/-- The restriction map from the chart `D₊(X₀)` to the overlap `D₊(X₀X₁)`. -/
48	noncomputable def awayToOverlapLeft :
49	    Away 𝒜 (X 0) →+* Away 𝒜 (X 0 * X 1) :=
50	  awayMap 𝒜 (X_mem k 1) rfl
51	
52	/-- The restriction map from the chart `D₊(X₁)` to the overlap `D₊(X₀X₁)`. -/
53	noncomputable def awayToOverlapRight :
54	    Away 𝒜 (X 1) →+* Away 𝒜 (X 0 * X 1) :=
55	  awayMap 𝒜 (X_mem k 0) (mul_comm (X 0) (X 1))
56	
57	theorem awayToOverlapLeft_eq :
58	    awayToOverlapLeft k = awayMap 𝒜 (X_mem k 1)
59	      (rfl : (X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) * X 1 = X 0 * X 1) :=
60	  rfl
61	
62	theorem awayToOverlapRight_eq :
63	    awayToOverlapRight k = awayMap 𝒜 (X_mem k 0) (mul_comm (X 0) (X 1)) :=
64	  rfl
65	
66	theorem awayToOverlapLeft_algebraMap (r : k) :
67	    awayToOverlapLeft k (algebraMap k _ r) = algebraMap k _ r :=
68	  awayMap_fromZeroRingHom 𝒜 (X_mem k 1)
69	    (rfl : (X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) * X 1 = X 0 * X 1) (algebraMap k (𝒜 0) r)
70	
71	theorem awayToOverlapRight_algebraMap (r : k) :
72	    awayToOverlapRight k (algebraMap k _ r) = algebraMap k _ r :=
73	  awayMap_fromZeroRingHom 𝒜 (X_mem k 0) (mul_comm (X 0) (X 1))
74	    (algebraMap k (𝒜 0) r)
75	
76	noncomputable instance : Algebra (Away 𝒜 (X 0)) (Away 𝒜 (X 0 * X 1)) :=
77	  (awayToOverlapLeft k).toAlgebra
78	
79	noncomputable instance : Algebra (Away 𝒜 (X 1)) (Away 𝒜 (X 0 * X 1)) :=
80	  (awayToOverlapRight k).toAlgebra

82	theorem isLocalizationElem_eq :
83	    Away.isLocalizationElem (X_mem k 0) (X_mem k 1) = chartCoord k 0 1 := by
84	  rw [Away.isLocalizationElem, chartCoord_eq]
85	  congr 1
86	  exact pow_one _

88	/-- The overlap ring is the localization of the chart ring `(k[X₀,X₁]_(X₀))₀ = k[t]` away
89	from the chart coordinate `t = X₁/X₀`. -/
90	instance : IsLocalization.Away (chartCoord k 0 1) (Away 𝒜 (X 0 * X 1)) := by
91	  have h : IsLocalization.Away (Away.isLocalizationElem (X_mem k 0) (X_mem k 1))
92	      (Away 𝒜 (X 0 * X 1)) :=
93	    Away.isLocalization_mul (X_mem k 0) (X_mem k 1)
94	      (rfl : (X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) * X 1 = X 0 * X 1) one_ne_zero
95	  rwa [isLocalizationElem_eq] at h

99	noncomputable def overlapRingEquiv :
100	    Away 𝒜 (X 0 * X 1) ≃+* LaurentPolynomial k :=
101	  IsLocalization.ringEquivOfRingEquiv (M := Submonoid.powers (chartCoord k 0 1))
102	    (T := Submonoid.powers (Polynomial.X : Polynomial k))
103	    (Away 𝒜 (X 0 * X 1)) (LaurentPolynomial k)
104	    (awayAlgEquiv k fin_zero_ne_one).toRingEquiv
105	    (by rw [Submonoid.map_powers]
106	        exact congrArg _ (awayAlgEquiv_chartCoord k fin_zero_ne_one))

108	theorem overlapRingEquiv_awayToOverlapLeft (z : Away 𝒜 (X 0)) :
109	    overlapRingEquiv k (awayToOverlapLeft k z) =
110	      Polynomial.toLaurent (awayAlgEquiv k fin_zero_ne_one z) := by
111	  rw [← LaurentPolynomial.algebraMap_eq_toLaurent]
112	  exact IsLocalization.ringEquivOfRingEquiv_eq _ _
113	
114	/-- The overlap identification: the section ring `(k[X₀,X₁]_(X₀X₁))₀` of the chart overlap is
115	the ring of Laurent polynomials over `k`, with `T = X₁/X₀`. -/
116	noncomputable def overlapAlgEquiv :
117	    Away 𝒜 (X 0 * X 1) ≃ₐ[k] LaurentPolynomial k :=
118	  { overlapRingEquiv k with
119	    commutes' := fun r => by
120	      change overlapRingEquiv k (algebraMap k _ r) = _
121	      rw [← awayToOverlapLeft_algebraMap, overlapRingEquiv_awayToOverlapLeft,
122	        AlgEquiv.commutes, ← Polynomial.C_eq_algebraMap, Polynomial.toLaurent_C,
123	        LaurentPolynomial.C_eq_algebraMap] }

125	theorem overlapAlgEquiv_apply (z : Away 𝒜 (X 0 * X 1)) :
126	    overlapAlgEquiv k z = overlapRingEquiv k z :=
127	  rfl

129	/-- Through the chart identifications, the left restriction map to the overlap is the
130	canonical map `k[t] → k[T,T⁻¹]`, `t ↦ T`. -/
131	theorem overlapAlgEquiv_awayToOverlapLeft (z : Away 𝒜 (X 0)) :
132	    overlapAlgEquiv k (awayToOverlapLeft k z) =
133	      Polynomial.toLaurent (awayAlgEquiv k fin_zero_ne_one z) :=
134	  overlapRingEquiv_awayToOverlapLeft k z

137	    awayToOverlapLeft k (chartCoord k 0 1) * awayToOverlapRight k (chartCoord k 1 0) = 1 := by
138	  rw [awayToOverlapLeft_eq, awayToOverlapRight_eq, chartCoord_eq k 0 1, chartCoord_eq k 1 0,

145	    overlapAlgEquiv k (awayToOverlapRight k (chartCoord k 1 0)) = LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) := by
146	  have h1 : (LaurentPolynomial.T 1 : LaurentPolynomial k) *
147	      overlapAlgEquiv k (awayToOverlapRight k (chartCoord k 1 0)) = 1 := by

152	  calc overlapAlgEquiv k (awayToOverlapRight k (chartCoord k 1 0))
153	      = (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) * LaurentPolynomial.T 1) *
154	          overlapAlgEquiv k (awayToOverlapRight k (chartCoord k 1 0)) := by
155	        rw [← LaurentPolynomial.T_add, neg_add_cancel, LaurentPolynomial.T_zero, one_mul]
156	    _ = LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) := by rw [mul_assoc, h1, mul_one]

158	/-- Through the chart identifications, the right restriction map to the overlap is the map
159	`k[t] → k[T,T⁻¹]`, `t ↦ T⁻¹`. -/
160	theorem overlapAlgEquiv_awayToOverlapRight (z : Away 𝒜 (X 1)) :
161	    overlapAlgEquiv k (awayToOverlapRight k z) =
162	      Polynomial.aeval (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) : LaurentPolynomial k)
163	        (awayAlgEquiv k fin_one_ne_zero z) := by

167	  | add f g hf hg => simp only [map_add, hf, hg]
168	  | monomial n a =>
169	    simp only [polyToAway_monomial, map_mul, map_pow,
170	      overlapAlgEquiv_awayToOverlapRight_chartCoord, awayToOverlapRight_algebraMap,
171	      AlgEquiv.commutes, Polynomial.aeval_monomial]
172	
173	/-! ### The Laurent span property on the overlap -/
174	
175	/-- **Laurent span, ring level**: every element of the overlap ring is the sum of a
176	restriction from the left chart and a restriction from the right chart. -/
177	theorem exists_awayToOverlap_add (w : Away 𝒜 (X 0 * X 1)) :
178	    ∃ (p : Away 𝒜 (X 0)) (q : Away 𝒜 (X 1)),
179	      w = awayToOverlapLeft k p + awayToOverlapRight k q := by
180	  obtain ⟨f₁, f₂, hf⟩ := LaurentPolynomial.exists_toLaurent_add_aeval (overlapAlgEquiv k w)
181	  refine ⟨(awayAlgEquiv k fin_zero_ne_one).symm f₁,
182	    (awayAlgEquiv k fin_one_ne_zero).symm f₂, (overlapAlgEquiv k).injective ?_⟩
183	  rw [map_add, overlapAlgEquiv_awayToOverlapLeft, overlapAlgEquiv_awayToOverlapRight,
184	    AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hf]
185	
186	/-! ### Section-level identifications -/
187	
188	theorem awayToSection_surjective {m : ℕ} (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (f_deg : f ∈ 𝒜 m)
189	    (hm : 0 < m) : Function.Surjective (Proj.awayToSection 𝒜 f).hom := fun z => by
190	  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway 𝒜 f f_deg hm).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.surjective z
191	  exact ⟨w, hw⟩
192	
193	theorem overlap_le_left : Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 (X 0 * X 1) ≤ chartOpen k 0 :=
194	  Proj.basicOpen_mono 𝒜 _ _ ⟨X 1, rfl⟩
195	
196	theorem overlap_le_right : Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 (X 0 * X 1) ≤ chartOpen k 1 :=
197	  Proj.basicOpen_mono 𝒜 _ _ ⟨X 0, mul_comm (X 0) (X 1)⟩
198	
199	theorem isAffineOpen_overlap : IsAffineOpen (Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 (X 0 * X 1)) :=
200	  Proj.isAffineOpen_basicOpen 𝒜 _ (X_mul_X_mem k) two_pos
201	
202	/-- Restriction of sections from the left chart to the overlap corresponds to
203	`P1.awayToOverlapLeft` under `Proj.awayToSection`. -/
204	theorem res_awayToSection_left (p : Away 𝒜 (X 0)) :
205	    ((P1 k).presheaf.map (homOfLE (overlap_le_left k)).op).hom
206	        ((Proj.awayToSection 𝒜 (X 0)).hom p) =
207	      (Proj.awayToSection 𝒜 (X 0 * X 1)).hom (awayToOverlapLeft k p) := by
208	  have h := Proj.awayMap_awayToSection 𝒜 (X_mem k 1)
209	    (rfl : (X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) * X 1 = X 0 * X 1)
210	  have h' := congr((CommRingCat.Hom.hom $h) p)
211	  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom] at h'
212	  exact h'.symm

215	`P1.awayToOverlapRight` under `Proj.awayToSection`. -/
216	theorem res_awayToSection_right (q : Away 𝒜 (X 1)) :
217	    ((P1 k).presheaf.map (homOfLE (overlap_le_right k)).op).hom
218	        ((Proj.awayToSection 𝒜 (X 1)).hom q) =
219	      (Proj.awayToSection 𝒜 (X 0 * X 1)).hom (awayToOverlapRight k q) := by

226	    e.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.symm (e.hom.hom x) = x := by
227	  change e.inv.hom (e.hom.hom x) = x
228	  have h := congr((CommRingCat.Hom.hom $(e.hom_inv_id)) x)

232	
233	/-- The identification of the section ring of the chart `D₊(X₀)` with `k[t]`, `t = X₁/X₀`. -/
234	noncomputable def chartSectionsEquiv₀ : Γ(P1 k, chartOpen k 0) ≃+* Polynomial k :=
235	  ((Proj.basicOpenIsoAway 𝒜 (X 0) (X_mem k 0) one_pos).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv).symm.trans
236	    (awayAlgEquiv k fin_zero_ne_one).toRingEquiv
237	
238	/-- The identification of the section ring of the chart `D₊(X₁)` with `k[t]`, `t = X₀/X₁`. -/
239	noncomputable def chartSectionsEquiv₁ : Γ(P1 k, chartOpen k 1) ≃+* Polynomial k :=
240	  ((Proj.basicOpenIsoAway 𝒜 (X 1) (X_mem k 1) one_pos).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv).symm.trans
241	    (awayAlgEquiv k fin_one_ne_zero).toRingEquiv
242	
243	/-- The identification of the section ring of the chart overlap `D₊(X₀X₁)` with the Laurent
244	polynomial ring, `T = X₁/X₀`. -/
245	noncomputable def overlapSectionsEquiv :
246	    Γ(P1 k, Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 (X 0 * X 1)) ≃+* LaurentPolynomial k :=
247	  ((Proj.basicOpenIsoAway 𝒜 (X 0 * X 1)
248	    (X_mul_X_mem k) two_pos).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv).symm.trans
249	    (overlapAlgEquiv k).toRingEquiv
250	
251	theorem chartSectionsEquiv₀_awayToSection (p : Away 𝒜 (X 0)) :
252	    chartSectionsEquiv₀ k ((Proj.awayToSection 𝒜 (X 0)).hom p) =
253	      awayAlgEquiv k fin_zero_ne_one p := by
254	  change (((Proj.basicOpenIsoAway 𝒜 (X 0) (X_mem k 0)
255	      one_pos).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv).symm.trans
256	      (awayAlgEquiv k fin_zero_ne_one).toRingEquiv)
257	      ((Proj.awayToSection 𝒜 (X 0)).hom p) = _
258	  rw [RingEquiv.trans_apply, ← Proj.basicOpenIsoAway_hom 𝒜 (X 0) (X_mem k 0) one_pos,

261	
262	theorem chartSectionsEquiv₁_awayToSection (q : Away 𝒜 (X 1)) :
263	    chartSectionsEquiv₁ k ((Proj.awayToSection 𝒜 (X 1)).hom q) =
264	      awayAlgEquiv k fin_one_ne_zero q := by
265	  change (((Proj.basicOpenIsoAway 𝒜 (X 1) (X_mem k 1)
266	      one_pos).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv).symm.trans
267	      (awayAlgEquiv k fin_one_ne_zero).toRingEquiv)
268	      ((Proj.awayToSection 𝒜 (X 1)).hom q) = _
269	  rw [RingEquiv.trans_apply, ← Proj.basicOpenIsoAway_hom 𝒜 (X 1) (X_mem k 1) one_pos,
270	    iso_symm_hom_apply]
271	  rfl
272	
273	theorem overlapSectionsEquiv_awayToSection (w : Away 𝒜 (X 0 * X 1)) :
274	    overlapSectionsEquiv k ((Proj.awayToSection 𝒜 (X 0 * X 1)).hom w) =
275	      overlapAlgEquiv k w := by
276	  change (((Proj.basicOpenIsoAway 𝒜 (X 0 * X 1)
277	      (X_mul_X_mem k) two_pos).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv).symm.trans
278	      (overlapAlgEquiv k).toRingEquiv)
279	      ((Proj.awayToSection 𝒜 (X 0 * X 1)).hom w) = _
280	  rw [RingEquiv.trans_apply, ← Proj.basicOpenIsoAway_hom 𝒜 (X 0 * X 1)
281	    (X_mul_X_mem k) two_pos, iso_symm_hom_apply]
282	  rfl
283	
284	/-- Through the section-level identifications, restriction from the left chart to the
285	overlap is `t ↦ T`. -/

import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Laurent
import Mathlib.RingTheory.TensorProduct.Maps
import Mathlib.RingTheory.TensorProduct.MonoidAlgebra
import Mathlib.RingTheory.PolynomialAlgebra
import Mathlib.Algebra.MonoidAlgebra.MapDomain

/-!
# Base change for polynomial and Laurent polynomial rings

For a commutative ring `k` and a `k`-algebra `A` we record the canonical algebra
equivalences

* `polyBaseChange`   : `k[X] ⊗[k] A ≃ₐ[k] A[X]`,
* `laurentBaseChange`: `k[T;T⁻¹] ⊗[k] A ≃ₐ[k] A[T;T⁻¹]`,

and compute their effect on the tensors `x ⊗ₜ 1`.  On such elements each equivalence
is the coefficient-change ring homomorphism induced by `algebraMap k A`: for
polynomials this is `Polynomial.map (algebraMap k A)`, and for Laurent polynomials it
is `AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom (algebraMap k A)` (there is no dedicated
`LaurentPolynomial.map` in mathlib).

The final two lemmas are the payload consumed by the scheme-level `ℙ¹` bridge: the two
`ℙ¹` chart maps `Polynomial.toLaurent` (`X ↦ T 1`) and
`Polynomial.eval₂RingHom C (T (-1))` (`X ↦ T (-1)`) intertwine base change with the
polynomial coefficient map.  These are pure commutative algebra.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open Polynomial LaurentPolynomial TensorProduct

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

variable {k A : Type u} [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]

/-- Base change for the polynomial ring: `k[X] ⊗[k] A ≃ₐ[k] A[X]`. -/
noncomputable def polyBaseChange (k A : Type u) [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] :
    (Polynomial k) ⊗[k] A ≃ₐ[k] Polynomial A :=
  (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm k (Polynomial k) A).trans (polyEquivTensor k A).symm

/-- Base change for the Laurent polynomial ring: `k[T;T⁻¹] ⊗[k] A ≃ₐ[k] A[T;T⁻¹]`. -/
noncomputable def laurentBaseChange (k A : Type u) [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] :
    (LaurentPolynomial k) ⊗[k] A ≃ₐ[k] LaurentPolynomial A :=
  (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm k (LaurentPolynomial k) A).trans
    (((AddMonoidAlgebra.tensorEquiv (M := ℤ) k A k).restrictScalars k).trans
      (AddMonoidAlgebra.mapAlgEquiv k ℤ (Algebra.TensorProduct.rid k k A)))

/-- The final coefficient-change equivalence sends a `single` to a `single`. -/
private lemma mapAlgEquiv_single (n : ℤ) (x : A ⊗[k] k) :
    (AddMonoidAlgebra.mapAlgEquiv k ℤ (Algebra.TensorProduct.rid k k A))
        (AddMonoidAlgebra.single n x)
      = AddMonoidAlgebra.single n (Algebra.TensorProduct.rid k k A x) := by
  rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.mapAlgEquiv_apply]; exact AddMonoidAlgebra.mapAlgHom_single _ _ _

/-- `laurentBaseChange` on a monomial tensor `single n c ⊗ₜ 1`. -/
private lemma lbc_single (n : ℤ) (c : k) :
    laurentBaseChange k A (AddMonoidAlgebra.single n c ⊗ₜ 1)
      = AddMonoidAlgebra.single n (algebraMap k A c) := by
  simp only [laurentBaseChange, AlgEquiv.trans_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_tmul,
    AlgEquiv.restrictScalars_apply, AddMonoidAlgebra.tensorEquiv_tmul,
    map_one, one_mul, AddMonoidAlgebra.mapAlgHom_single, mapAlgEquiv_single,
    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.rid_tmul,
    Algebra.smul_def, mul_one]

/-- On `x ⊗ₜ 1`, Laurent base change is the coefficient-change ring homomorphism induced
by `algebraMap k A`. -/
theorem laurentBaseChange_tmul_one (x : LaurentPolynomial k) :
    laurentBaseChange k A (x ⊗ₜ[k] 1)
      = AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom (M := ℤ) (algebraMap k A) x := by
  have h : ((laurentBaseChange k A).toAlgHom.toRingHom.comp
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom))
      = (AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom (M := ℤ) (algebraMap k A)) := by
    apply AddMonoidAlgebra.ringHom_ext ?_ ?_
    · intro r
      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom_apply]
      change laurentBaseChange k A (AddMonoidAlgebra.single 0 r ⊗ₜ 1) = _
      rw [lbc_single, AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom_single]
    · intro m
      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom_apply]
      change laurentBaseChange k A (AddMonoidAlgebra.single m 1 ⊗ₜ 1) = _
      rw [lbc_single, AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom_single, map_one]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h x

/-- Laurent base change fixes the constant `C c ⊗ₜ 1 ↦ C (algebraMap k A c)`. -/
theorem laurentBaseChange_C (c : k) :
    laurentBaseChange k A (LaurentPolynomial.C c ⊗ₜ 1)
      = LaurentPolynomial.C (algebraMap k A c) := by
  rw [← LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C, lbc_single, LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C]

/-- Laurent base change fixes the generator `T n ⊗ₜ 1 ↦ T n`. -/
theorem laurentBaseChange_T (n : ℤ) :
    laurentBaseChange k A (LaurentPolynomial.T n ⊗ₜ 1) = LaurentPolynomial.T n := by
  rw [LaurentPolynomial.T, lbc_single, map_one, LaurentPolynomial.T]

/-- `polyBaseChange` fixes the constant `C c ⊗ₜ 1 ↦ C (algebraMap k A c)`. -/
theorem polyBaseChange_C (c : k) :
    polyBaseChange k A (Polynomial.C c ⊗ₜ 1) = Polynomial.C (algebraMap k A c) := by
  simp only [polyBaseChange, AlgEquiv.trans_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_tmul,
    polyEquivTensor_symm_apply_tmul, ← Polynomial.C_eq_algebraMap,
    Polynomial.sum_C_index, one_mul, map_zero, Polynomial.monomial_zero_left]

/-- `polyBaseChange` fixes the generator `X ⊗ₜ 1 ↦ X`. -/
theorem polyBaseChange_X : polyBaseChange k A (Polynomial.X ⊗ₜ 1) = Polynomial.X := by
  simp only [polyBaseChange, AlgEquiv.trans_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_tmul,
    polyEquivTensor_symm_apply_tmul]
  simp [Polynomial.X, Polynomial.sum_monomial_index]

/-- On `p ⊗ₜ 1`, polynomial base change is `Polynomial.map (algebraMap k A)`. -/
theorem polyBaseChange_tmul_one (p : Polynomial k) :
    polyBaseChange k A (p ⊗ₜ[k] 1) = Polynomial.map (algebraMap k A) p := by
  have h : ((polyBaseChange k A).toAlgHom.toRingHom.comp
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom))
      = (Polynomial.mapRingHom (algebraMap k A)) := by
    apply Polynomial.ringHom_ext ?_ ?_
    · intro c
      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom_apply]
      change polyBaseChange k A (Polynomial.C c ⊗ₜ 1) = _
      rw [polyBaseChange_C, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_C]
    · rw [RingHom.comp_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom_apply]
      change polyBaseChange k A (Polynomial.X ⊗ₜ 1) = _
      rw [polyBaseChange_X, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_X]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h p

/-- Naturality of the left chart map `Polynomial.toLaurent` under coefficient change. -/
theorem mapRingHom_toLaurent (p : Polynomial k) :
    AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom (M := ℤ) (algebraMap k A) (Polynomial.toLaurent p)
      = Polynomial.toLaurent (Polynomial.map (algebraMap k A) p) := by
  have h : (AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom (M := ℤ) (algebraMap k A)).comp
      (Polynomial.toLaurent (R := k))
      = (Polynomial.toLaurent (R := A)).comp (Polynomial.mapRingHom (algebraMap k A)) := by
    apply Polynomial.ringHom_ext ?_ ?_
    · intro c
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.toLaurent_C, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom,
        Polynomial.map_C, ← LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C,
        AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom_single]
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.toLaurent_X, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom,
        Polynomial.map_X, LaurentPolynomial.T, AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom_single, map_one]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h p

/-- Naturality of the right chart map `eval₂RingHom C (T (-1))` under coefficient change. -/
theorem mapRingHom_rightChart (p : Polynomial k) :
    AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom (M := ℤ) (algebraMap k A)
        (Polynomial.eval₂RingHom LaurentPolynomial.C (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)) p)
      = Polynomial.eval₂RingHom LaurentPolynomial.C (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1))
          (Polynomial.map (algebraMap k A) p) := by
  have h : (AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom (M := ℤ) (algebraMap k A)).comp
      (Polynomial.eval₂RingHom (LaurentPolynomial.C (R := k)) (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)))
      = (Polynomial.eval₂RingHom (LaurentPolynomial.C (R := A)) (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1))).comp
          (Polynomial.mapRingHom (algebraMap k A)) := by
    apply Polynomial.ringHom_ext ?_ ?_
    · intro c
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.coe_eval₂RingHom, Polynomial.eval₂_C,
        Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_C, ← LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C,
        AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom_single]
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.coe_eval₂RingHom, Polynomial.eval₂_X,
        Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_X, LaurentPolynomial.T,
        AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom_single, map_one]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h p

/-- Left chart intertwining: base change commutes with `Polynomial.toLaurent`. -/
theorem laurentBaseChange_toLaurent (p : Polynomial k) :
    laurentBaseChange k A (Polynomial.toLaurent p ⊗ₜ[k] 1)
      = Polynomial.toLaurent (Polynomial.map (algebraMap k A) p) := by
  rw [laurentBaseChange_tmul_one, mapRingHom_toLaurent]

/-- Right chart intertwining: base change commutes with `eval₂RingHom C (T (-1))`. -/
theorem laurentBaseChange_rightChart (p : Polynomial k) :
    laurentBaseChange k A
        (Polynomial.eval₂RingHom LaurentPolynomial.C (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)) p ⊗ₜ[k] 1)
      = Polynomial.eval₂RingHom LaurentPolynomial.C (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1))
          (Polynomial.map (algebraMap k A) p) := by
  rw [laurentBaseChange_tmul_one, mapRingHom_rightChart]

end AlgebraicGeometry
